exposure: local anesthesia alone (paracervical block with 20 mL of 1% buffered lidocaine)
local anesthesia plus intravenous (IV) moderate sedation with 100 mcg of fentanyl and 2 mg of midazolam
being afraid of a minor medical procedure
history of prior vaginal or cesarean delivery or induced abortion
outcome: Patient satisfaction with pain control regimen
cohort: 304 patients undergoing procedural abortion at <12 weeks' gestation in the outpatient setting
finding: Fear of minor medical procedures was the only variable that predicted decreased satisfaction with local anesthesia alone for procedural abortion under 12 weeks.
mod_finding: The study mentions prior cesarean delivery as a factor but finds no association between it and satisfaction levels with pain control regimens during procedural abortion.
